name: alert
useFor: Use Alert for a message about the page or the workspace that stays until it is resolved (a failed check, a usage limit close at hand, a connected repository). Put one glyph first, a short title, and a sentence of detail; an action goes in AlertAction. For a passing confirmation, use a toast.
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: its square frames on quiet lines (.hn__news), 14px notes and the orange used only as a mark
title: Alert
description: A ruled notice: a square block inside a quiet edge, a 16px Phosphor glyph beside a 14px medium title and 14px graphite text. Destructive takes the orange edge and glyph; success and warning a glyph in their status color.
